ideas.title: Move the backup Atlas from Haiku 4.5 to Haiku 5.5 (and add its price)
ideas.problem: settings.py line 12 sets MODELS['atlas'] = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', used by the API backup Atlas (agents.py Atlas.chat, llm.run). It is the only 4.x model we still call. Haiku 4.5's retirement date is 'not sooner than 2026-10-15' (already passed, though no notice was issued; Anthropic promises 60 days' notice). Also PRICES_PER_MTOK has no entry for Haiku 5.5: control_plane.py line 239 falls back to (5.0, 25.0) for unknown models, so a plain ID swap would count its cost about 50x too high and could trip the daily budget or the Atlas cap.
ideas.proposal: 1) settings.py: MODELS['atlas'] = 'claude-haiku-5-5'. 2) Add to PRICES_PER_MTOK: 'claude-haiku-5-5': (0.10, 0.50) and keep the 4-5 line one more month. Note Haiku 5.5 costs $0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100k tokens; Atlas's backup prompts are far below that. 3) Also change the Atlas limit default if it lists the model (cp.LIMITS model.atlas) so the office's Limits tab shows the new name. settings.py is on Ghassan's PROTECTED list, so the Builder does this, not Ghassan.
ideas.gain: Backup Atlas input/output cost falls 10x ($1/$5 -> $0.10/$0.50 per MTok) and we leave the oldest model before it gets a retirement notice. In absolute terms small: the backup only answers when Claude Code is unavailable. Measure: events model_call for Atlas show the new model and cost_usd about a tenth of before for a similar message.
ideas.test: Normal: in practice mode with HQ_ATLAS_ENGINE=api, send 'status' and 'list ideas'; Atlas answers and calls the right tools. Edge: a message needing 3 tool calls (spend report then list ideas then retry); tool-calling still works with Haiku 5.5. Failure: remove the price line and confirm the cost is wrongly counted at the (5, 25) default, to prove the price entry is needed. One real run (a few cents) to check the model ID is accepted before shipping.
ideas.confidence_why: Prices, ID and retirement dates are from Anthropic's own pages (A). Weakest link: no test of Haiku 5.5 quality as Atlas's tool-using backup.
ideas.risks: Haiku 5.5 may answer in a different style or call tools differently than 4.5; the backup is rarely used, so impact is low. Easy to revert (one line).
